headline: The ADVENTURE guide learns to walk like a player
lede: Resumed the roaming-dragons PR: five rounds of trace-driven fixes took the watch guide from a slaughter roulette to zero deaths and a perfect FAST-variant sweep. The corridor route now arms the sword first, exactly like the cart's opening.

notes.text: Mobility v3 on forge/adventure-polish (PR #3505): arm-first sword ride (goldKey → Gold Castle → sword — Yorgle flees the gold key by his own 1980 law), calm-entry at every door, and a 24-tick progress-window EVICT that finally sees through collision jitter at maze corners.

Two hidden mechanics found by tracing, not guessing: diagonal pushes vs the 4-way cell BFS produced 1px-per-3-tick crawls a dragon could outrun; and items dropped on a door threshold spawned INSIDE the wall band (y=194 on a 192-tall room) — permanently unreachable keys. Both fixed at the root.

Still WIP: two V1 seeds and one V3 seed exhaust the pre-roam 60k tick budget in honest bat-and-roam waits. The resume plan (shared wait credit + errand re-order when the bat hoards loot) is written on the PR.
